name: Mip-Splatting Rasterization Pipeline
definition: A differentiable rasterization pipeline for 3D Gaussians that handles view-dependent scaling (mip-splatting) via a kernel_size parameter and uses a tile-based binning and sorting approach for efficient rendering.
summary: The Mip-Splatting Rasterization Pipeline is a differentiable GPU rendering method for 3D Gaussian Splatting that uses view-dependent scaling to handle aliasing and resolution changes.
